execution_trigger: 2026-09-04 result-blind workflow trigger; no estimand, pool, variable, or decision rule changed
analysis_role: Post-result causal-boundary falsification. Test whether the current East-Asian orientation-BIO15 correspondence persists after removing coarse regional and geographic placement explanations. This analysis cannot establish climatic selection or adaptation.

A_japan_only.question: Does the BIO15 orientation contrast retain its direction after removing the Taiwan-Japan regional split?
A_japan_only.model: same Brownian PGLS y ~ orientation on the seven Japan-source taxa, repeated across the same six accepted AU topologies
A_japan_only.robustness: species leave-one-out within the seven-taxon Japan-only panel
A_japan_only.decision: directionally_persistent if all six topology coefficients and all evaluable species-LOO coefficients retain the prespecified sign; otherwise geographically_fragile

B_geography_adjusted.question: Does orientation retain a BIO15 coefficient after coarse spatial position is included explicitly?
B_geography_adjusted.primary_model: Brownian GLS y ~ orientation + z(mean_latitude) + z(mean_longitude) on all nine taxa
B_geography_adjusted.sensitivity_model: Brownian GLS y ~ orientation + Taiwan_indicator on all nine taxa
B_geography_adjusted.decision: geography_adjusted_direction_retained if the orientation coefficient retains the prespecified sign on all six topologies in the primary model; otherwise geography_explains_or_destabilizes_direction
B_geography_adjusted.small_n_boundary: n=9; coefficients are diagnostics, not definitive causal estimates

C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.question: Among alternative U=5/D=4 maps, does the observed BIO15 contrast remain exceptional after recurrence and coarse geography are both matched?
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.geographic_distance: standardize each geographic feature across all 126 maps, then Euclidean distance from the observed map
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.geography_nearest_pool: lowest geographic-distance quartile among exact-recurrence maps; deterministic tie handling by assignment_id
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.joint_distance: rank-normalized depth_distance + rank-normalized geographic_distance among exact-recurrence maps
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.joint_nearest_pool: lowest joint-distance quartile among exact-recurrence maps; deterministic tie handling by assignment_id
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.primary_statistic: median signed six-topology BIO15 PGLS effect from the frozen counterfactual analysis
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.reverse_direction: report whether an opposite-sign map exists in each conditioned pool
C_geography_conditioned_counterfactual.interpretation: A low conditional rank after geography conditioning would strengthen a non-random climate correspondence beyond coarse geography; loss of extremeness would indicate that geography/history jointly explain the apparent association. Finite ranks are not P values.

claim_ceiling: No result establishes precipitation seasonality as a selective agent.
No result establishes adaptation, plasticity, or transition-time historical causation.
Latitude/longitude adjustment is a coarse geography diagnostic and cannot remove all spatial or lineage confounding.
Japan-only support would be regional persistence, not independent replication.
Counterfactual conditional fractions are finite ranks, not P values or posterior probabilities.
No new climate variables may be added after result inspection.
